originalTitle: Sodium ion battery for $10/kWh by EOY 2026?
title: 2026 年底前会有 ≤10 美元/kWh 的可下单钠离子电池吗？
Will an orderable sodium-ion battery cost ≤$10/kWh by end-2026?
rules: 2026-12-31 23:59:59 UTC 前，新可充钠离子电芯、模组或整包的价格/标称电量须 ≤10 美元/kWh；不含税、关税和运费。
By 23:59:59 UTC on 31 December 2026, a new rechargeable sodium-ion cell, module or pack must be offered/sold at ≤$10 per nominal kWh, excluding taxes, duties and shipping.
网页证据须有截止日前 Wayback 存档；非美元按报价日 ECB 汇率。排除二手、原型、隐性补贴和无法拆分的捆绑报价。
Web evidence needs a pre-deadline Wayback capture; non-USD prices use the listing-date ECB rate. Used/prototype, undisclosed-rebate and inseparable bundle prices are excluded.
interpretation: 本题允许电芯、模组或整包，价格分母是标称电量。材料便宜、厂商发布或预估成本都还不是可下单成交依据；还需核对存档日与汇率。
The product may be a cell, module or pack, using nominal energy. Cheap feedstock, launches and estimated costs are not orderable quotations; archive date and exchange-rate evidence still matter.

summary: 本题允许电芯、模组或整包，价格分母是标称电量。材料便宜、厂商发布或预估成本都还不是可下单成交依据；还需核对存档日与汇率。
The product may be a cell, module or pack, using nominal energy. Cheap feedstock, launches and estimated costs are not orderable quotations; archive date and exchange-rate evidence still matter.
checklist: 核对型号、可订购状态、单价与标称 Wh。
Match model, availability, unit price and nominal Wh.
保存同日报价、网页存档与 ECB 汇率。
Keep quotation, archive and ECB rate for the relevant date.
区分已披露性能与未经厂家报价支持的低价背景。
Separate reported performance from unsupported low-price background claims.

stage: 材料降本 → 制造成品 → 可核验报价
impact: 钠离子的材料和制造选择会影响比能量、循环与成本，但报价必须覆盖同一层级成品。CATL 第一代公告可用于了解普鲁士白与硬碳路线，以及室温快充的披露口径；它没有证实这个极低价格门槛，不能将发布会性能数据作为价格达成证据。

Materials and manufacturing affect energy, cycling and cost, but price must match the same product level. CATL’s first-generation release explains the Prussian-white/hard-carbon route and charging claims; it does not establish this exceptionally low price threshold.
gap: 原市场背景称 CATL 将推出低价电池，本站未将该句作为厂商定价事实；最终需符合规则的产品报价。
The contract background’s low-price assertion is not treated as manufacturer pricing; qualifying product documentation is still needed.

title: 钠离子成本：报价分母与交付层级
Sodium-ion cost: price denominators and product levels
principle: 钠元素资源丰富并不直接决定电芯售价。正负极、集流体、电解液、制造良率和质保都影响成品成本。用美元/kWh 比较时，电芯、模组与整包必须分别注明，能量按题目要求用标称值。

Abundant sodium does not alone set cell prices. Electrodes, collectors, electrolyte, yield and warranty contribute. State cell/module/pack level and use the contract’s nominal-energy denominator for $/kWh.
example: 一件 1 kWh 产品只有在可下单价格不高于 10 美元且满足规则的存档、汇率和排除条件时才进入本题判定。CATL 2021 年的 160 Wh/kg 是比能量，不是 160 美元/kWh；本题背景中的廉价电池说法不代替厂家价目表。

A 1 kWh product needs a qualifying orderable price no higher than $10, with the required archive, exchange rate and exclusions. CATL’s historical 160 Wh/kg is specific energy, not price; the contract’s background assertion does not replace a manufacturer quotation.

detail: 背景中的 CATL 低价说法不作为厂商报价；报价日、存档与成品层级必须符合正文。
The background CATL assertion is not manufacturer pricing; listing date, archive and product level must satisfy the body.

Few participants

Few participants contribute; review activity and source rules.
